title: X rolls out its first parental controls for users aged 13 to 17, defaulting teens to protected mode, restricting sensitive media, and disabling targeted ads (Steve Dent/Engadget)
summary: Steve Dent / Engadget: X rolls out its first parental controls for users aged 13 to 17, defaulting teens to protected mode, restricting sensitive media, and disabling targeted ads — Any responsible adult should probably check on their teen's X usage. — Elon Musk's X has finally introduced parental controls …
contentText:
Steve Dent / Engadget :

X rolls out its first parental controls for users aged 13 to 17, defaulting teens to protected mode, restricting sensitive media, and disabling targeted ads   —  Any responsible adult should probably check on their teen's X usage.  —  Elon Musk's X has finally introduced parental controls …
